body:
Claim: PM loop round 9 — flight V, maintainer-directed (「同意，这几个都处理，你现在就负责派发」, 2026-09-07): the merge queue's Test Core runs the affected package set. `merge_group` computes the set with turbo `--affected` against the group's base and the same cross-package scan union the `pull_request` branch applies; `push` on `main` keeps the full list; an empty selection on a docs-only group is an honest green through the existing no-packages path. The selection logic moves out of the inline step into a script with a self-test so the three synthetic groups can be proved locally; the PR's own first queue run is the live proof, read by the seat.
Session: `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`
Branch: `claude/issue-16453-merge-group-affected-set`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-16453`
Domain: `domain:devx` (dispatched by the skills seat on the maintainer's direction)
File surface: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the "Compute this shard's package set" step only) and one new script under `scripts/ci/` with its self-test; `scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs` only if an empty roster does not already attest as judged. ⛔ No timings, shard count or wall change.
Container & model: M, `mode:subagent`, fable — Clause-② yes (the required `Test Core` check verifies a narrower set at merge time); on a fable 429 the seat's exemption applies, opus, recorded here.
Clause-②: yes
Serial: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is shared with flight X (#16455, a different step); whichever pushes second proves `git merge-tree --write-tree` clean against the other's pushed head, twice (the second with `-c merge.os-regen.driver=false`). Not governed ⇒ in-seat review, then the seat flips ready and arms SQUASH auto-merge; `skip-changeset`. The PR carries `Fixes #16453`.
